description: This topics course explores a Spanish peninsular cultural, literary, and/or linguistic theme from a base in Spain through analysis and discussion of texts, guest lectures, excursions to appropriate cultural sites, field research, and related experiential activities. Sample topics include: Christians, Jews, and Muslims in Spain; Food, Migration, and Identity; and Spain's Multilingual and Multicultural Landscape. Taught in Spanish. Offered alternate years during January term. Apply through Smith Center for Global Engagement. Prerequisite: SPAN 250 or SPAN 251.
name: Food-Migration-Identity in Spain
notes: This is a study abroad course. You will find this course listed in Studio Abroad
title: Spain's Cultural and Linguistic Legacy
